subject: Regulatory safeguard credit structure for EU pilot — HelixCare
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@helixcare.com>, HelixCare Procurement <procurement@helixcare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Regulatory safeguard credit structure for EU pilot — HelixCare

Aisha / HelixCare team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Below is a concise proposal for the EU pilot package and how we can structure credits to keep procurement simple while limiting Redwood's one-time concessions. This is focused on the compliance/security add-ons you flagged: audit logs, KMS/HSM, and EU residency.

Summary (pilot offer):
- HSM: up to 2 HSM seats for pilot; option A: 60% credit on list for first 3 months (one-time credit applied as invoice credit) OR option B: pay full price but receive $X monthly usage credit (we recommend option A).
- Audit logs: include up to 180 days retention for the pilot (no additional charge for first 90 days; standard audit-retention fees apply thereafter).
- Residency: EU region hosting enabled; residency surcharge waived for pilot (first 90 days).
- Evidence/attestation: SOC2 & KMS attestation materials available in attachment; we can provide an on-demand audit bundle for procurement.

Next steps we need from you:
1) Confirm preferred HSM credit option (A or B) and pilot start window (we suggested Jan 10 in the call).
2) Procurement PO or signature on the attached SOW stub to lock credits.
3) Any data-evidence routing constraints for EU CloudOps partner (cc'd) so we can include in SOW.

Attached: HelixCare_pilot_SOW_stub.pdf (SOW + acceptance criteria), Redwood_pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx (line-itemed pricing + amortization options).

Happy to hop on a quick alignment call if helpful — I included Laura and Markus to expedite approvals on our side.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: HelixCare_pilot_SOW_stub.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: Redwood_pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx (workbook)

From: Dr. Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@helixcare.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelixCare Procurement <procurement@helixcare.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Regulatory safeguard credit structure for EU pilot — HelixCare

Sergio,

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifying questions from clinical ops / infra before we route to procurement/legal: 

1) HSM custody: are keys customer-managed in our KMS (BYOK) or does Redwood host the keys with HSM in our tenant? We need to understand inability for Redwood to export keys.
2) The 60% credit number — is that refundable if we cancel before 3 months? Or is it an up-front invoice credit applied against the first invoice(s)?
3) Audit-log retention: does the 180-day pilot include the full ingest volume for our expected 2M monthly events, or is there a cap? If there is a per-GB charge beyond X, please specify.
4) Residency: will EU-hosted workloads be logically isolated (VPC) and will logs ever be routed to a US-based backup by default?

Procurement: please confirm PO timetables; we are aiming to review internally and, if accepted, return something by Jan 5. Legal will want a short data-processing addendum.

Best,
Aisha Qureshi, MD
VP Clinical Technology, HelixCare
aisha.qureshi@helixcare.com

> On Mon, 21 Dec 2026 at 09:12, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the call this morning. Below is a concise proposal...

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Regulatory safeguard credit structure for EU pilot — HelixCare

Sergio — looping in internal approvers. Quick notes on concessions and our recommended guardrails: 

- HSM credit approach: recommend offering the 60% credit as an invoice credit applied across the first 3 invoices (rather than a cash refund). Limits our exposure and keeps bookkeeping simple. Mark it as one-time concession line item on the SOW.
- Audit logs: include up to 2TB total for first 90 days; above that bill at standard auditlog rate in workbook. For 2M events/month we should call out expected GB/day in the workbook; I already added an "expected ingest" worksheet.
- Residency: waive residency surcharge for first 90 days but require explicit sign-off on the SOW to remove waiver thereafter.
- DPA: Legal will require standard DPA + EU SCCs; push that to a short redline and we'll accept most data-processing language.

Markus: can you confirm margin impact if we do 60% credit on 2 seats for 3 months and waive residency fee for 90 days? If it looks out of band we may need to cap to 1 seat credited.

—Laura

> On Mon, 21 Dec 2026 at 13:45, Dr. Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@helixcare.com> wrote:
> > Sergio, Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifying questions...

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Regulatory safeguard credit structure for EU pilot — HelixCare

Team — ran the numbers quickly: 

- Baseline list: HSM seat list = $2,500 / seat / month. Two seats for three months = $15,000 list. A 60% credit reduces customer cash to $6,000 (we absorb $9,000 in concession).
- Residency surcharge typical = $1,200 / month for EU region for this profile; waiving 90 days = ~$3,600 concession.
- Audit-log baseline we can absorb up to 2TB free for 90 days; above that bill at $0.20/GB. Estimated concession for 2TB = ~$400.

Total one-time concession impact (approx): $9,000 + $3,600 + $400 = $12,,~000 rounded. Finance can accept for strategic pilot but we should: 
1) Limit credit to apply only if signed SOW received before Jan 12 start.
2) Cap to 2 seats for pilot and require consumption reporting.
3) Make credits non-refundable; applied as invoice credit.

If procurement asks for a deeper discount we should require a 12-month minimum commit to trade down.

-Markus

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@helixcare.com>, HelixCare Procurement <procurement@helixcare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, EU CloudOps Partner <eu-ops@cloudpartner.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Final pilot credit proposal & next steps (SOW + DocuSign)

Aisha / Procurement team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the helpful clarifying questions. Based on internal approvals here's the final pilot offer and how it will be documented in the attached SOW: 

Final offer (deliverables for pilot):
- HSM: up to 2 HSM seats covered; 60% invoice credit applied across the first 3 invoices. Credits are one-time, non-refundable, and contingent on signed SOW received by Jan 12.
- Audit logs: first 90 days — up to 2TB ingest and 180-day retention at no additional pilot charge; thereafter billed at $0.20/GB/month for retention above 90 days.
- Residency: EU-hosted workloads in customer VPC; residency surcharge waived for first 90 days. Logs will remain in EU by default; we will not route backups to the US without written approval.
- Key custody: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM in the tenant; Redwood will not export customer keys. We'll include the KMS attestation in the evidence bundle.

Operational checkpoints:
- SOW acceptance and PO needed to lock credits and start by Jan 10–Jan 15 window.
- Monthly consumption report during pilot; credits revoke if we detect >2 seats actively used beyond the pilot scope.

Links: SOW for signature — https://www.docusign.com/EXAMPLE-HelixCare-Pilot (placeholder)
Drive (pricing workbook & attestations) — https://drive.redwood.com/drive/pricing/HLX-2026-09

If this looks good I can route the SOW to your procurement contact and legal; please confirm and we will send DocuSign.

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: HelixCare_pilot_SOW_stub.pdf
Attachment: Redwood_pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx
